main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body ATK%/CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG, Feet ATK%/SPD, Sphere ATK%/Lightning DMG, Rope ATK%. GUESS: Body CRIT Rate (proxy +4.1% over CRIT DMG body, +5.5% over ATK% body). GUESS: Feet SPD, because benchmarks.md:65 builds its 0% baseline with SPD boots and the timeline cares about SPD; Fribbels lists ATK% first. Sphere Lightning DMG over ATK% (proxy +10.7%). Rope ATK% is the only option.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, ATK%, ATK. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: the crit rolls fill their caps (CRIT DMG 12, CRIT Rate 10 with a CRIT Rate body); ATK% and ATK get none. SPD: 2 rolls. 101 base + 25.032 (SPD boots) + 4.6 (2 fixed rolls) = 130.63, and 2 distributed rolls make 135.23, the fewest that pass 133.34. Fribbels has no SPD target for Acheron (its benchmark copies the scanned build's SPD, benchmarks.md:69 and :82). Later thresholds: 143 (cycles 1 and 3) needs about 6 rolls and 160 about 13; not taken. SPD arithmetic ignores light cone and team SPD buffs. The cycle-1 two-turn threshold is 133.34 (20000/150); src/engine/breakpoints.test.ts pins 134 as 2 turns and 133 as 1.
